research.title: NCETM — Adding and subtracting within one whole
research.retrieval: Official HTML teaching points1–4 read, not a claim of reading every downloadable slide.
research.use: Same-unit numerator arithmetic, inverse operations, whole represented as n/n.
research.ageAdaptation: English Year3 comparator narrowed to Finnish frozen grades3–6 scope; not an OPH mandate or efficacy result.
research.licence: Conceptual corroboration and link only. No external text, drawings or downloads reproduced.

research.title: NRICH — A4 Fraction Addition
research.retrieval: Official University of Cambridge problem read; associated subtraction link not opened. Shared paper/unit idea reused for subtraction, not a false subtraction-source retrieval claim.
research.use: Define one whole explicitly and use physical paper pieces to relate area and numerical fractions.
research.ageAdaptation: Age7–11; different denominators and mixed numbers in the original are outside this initial same-denominator lesson.
research.licence: Copyright restrictions preserved. Original Finnish words/SVG only, no source figures or learner work copied.
